'''Kritt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] resident of [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]] who died along with his wife [[Fola]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] during a cyclone. He and his family had been neighbors of [[Po Reggis|Po]] and [[Jiki Reggis]].
